acceptance_criteria.description: docx_engine is the only code path that tags or fills documents; frontend contains no docxtemplater dependency and only renders previews
A fixture where selected text spans 3 runs tags correctly with formatting from the first run preserved
Filling a template with an unclosed tag returns a structured error naming the tag, never a corrupted docx
templates table stores storage_path only; a saved template round-trips through filesystem storage
A 15MB template transfers across the Tauri bridge via binary payload without Base64 in the hot path
PDF export succeeds on a clean Windows VM with no LibreOffice installed
All four export paths (docx, pdf, html preview, dfpkg bundle) produce valid output artifacts
Creator can upload, define all five field types, preview highlights, and save a template
Filler can fill all field types, preview, and export; invalid values raise per-field structured errors
A template can be versioned through all four states and rolled back to a prior version
Each RBAC role is enforced: viewer cannot edit; filler cannot publish; approver cannot bypass review
A draft template is not fillable by non-creators until approved and published
Every generation writes an immutable audit entry; admin can export the audit log
Admin console surfaces users, seats, licenses, library, audit viewer, and aggregate usage reports
License activation works offline; Pro honors 2-device limit; enterprise license file activates without phone-home
CLI generates a document from template + JSON data; REST bridge serves generation; webhook fires on success
Strict CSP active; a crafted docx with embedded script cannot execute in the preview renderer
Non-docx files and malformed zips are rejected with clear errors; file picker paths validated against traversal
Stored template files encrypted on Windows; audit of telemetry payloads confirms no document content
Telemetry is opt-in via consent screen; enterprise build ships with telemetry disabled and no crash-report upload
SAML login works against a test IdP; on-prem build runs air-gapped; MSI deploys silently via policy file
Auto-update installs a signed release and can roll back; SBOM attached to the release manifest
A bundle manifest round-trips through .dfpkg import/export preserving identity, documents, field schema, mappings, rules, and output config
Publishing a bundle version seals it; any edit creates a new version and generation references the exact version used
A bundle .dfpkg package imports and exports fully offline with no cloud dependency
All 13 field types validate their values; every schema attribute (id, label, description, type, required, default, validation, group, options, format) is enforced
Shared and document-specific field groups persist their scope; the UI renders them as visually separate sections
Four different placeholders in different documents map to one canonical field and resolve to the same value
A matter stores the exact bundle_version_id it was created against; matter data is stored separately from the bundle definition
One matter data entry fills every document in the bundle with no per-document re-entry
Matter creation flow completes end to end: select bundle, grouped form, validate, preview, generate
Validation runs at field, matter, and bundle levels with exact field/document identification in diagnostics
A generation run captures the input snapshot, exact bundle version, and engine version; run records are append-only
Historical generated documents are never mutated; any change produces a new run with new artifacts
Generate-all and generate-selected produce correctly named DOCX/PDF outputs; generation history lists every run
A conditional document is skipped with its reason shown in the generation preview
Rule expressions parse and type-check; function calls, loops, and unknown fields are rejected before storage
The bundle health check flags an unmapped placeholder with the exact document and field
No legal or company-secretarial vocabulary is hard-coded in the core domain modules
No docx manipulation exists anywhere under src/; all generation stays in the Rust docx_engine
